body.estimand_functional: For \((G,P)\in\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\) satisfying the query-local first-jet-determining and fibre-coherence hypotheses, \(\operatorname{RankPeel}(P_X,R^{\mathrm{law}}_{P_X})=\widehat G\) and \([\widehat G]=\theta_G\). No identifying equality is asserted for all of \(\mathcal M_{\mathrm{PNHZ}}\).

sampling_model.design: Population observational identification; there is no intervention or randomization design.
sampling_model.units: One scalar random vector indexed by the finite layered vertex set, with only \(X\) observed.
sampling_model.treatment: None; the target is the causal structure rather than a treatment effect.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The analysis is at the population-oracle level and excludes the cost of evaluating or estimating conditional-mean Jacobian ranks. On the strict query-local first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent subclass, every requested rank is version-stable and supports the recovery theorem; on the unchanged published class RankPeel may return \(\bot\). No finite-sample Jacobian estimator, rank-test calibration, or image-data consistency result is asserted.

comparator_promise_table.comparator_claim: The full binary adjacency matrix is identifiable up to permutation of latent variables, using measured pure descendants as recursive surrogates in an exhaustive subset construction.
The proposed algorithm can find the correct Markov equivalence class of the whole graph asymptotically under proper restrictions.
The estimated variable and the true variable are equivalent up to an invertible transformation.
Trek separation gives a complete characterization of when covariance submatrices drop rank and their generic lower rank.

body.tldr: Prashant, Ng, Zhang, and Huang identify the full binary adjacency matrix of their nonlinear latent hierarchy and reuse measured pure descendants as higher-layer surrogates. RankPeel gives a deterministic pairwise-block and representative-deletion protocol with at most \(p^2+p\) observed rank queries, \(O(p^3)\) bookkeeping, and an oracle-relative replay record. An explicit smooth one-latent four-measurement member of the unchanged published class has two admissible conditional-mean versions with different Jacobian ranks, so full-class law-invariant recovery is false. Exact RankPeel recovery is therefore claimed only on the strict query-local first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent subclass; fibre coherence is latent and separator-relative, not observable. The parentless test, private-path lower bound, pure-surrogate cuts, and topological bottleneck are proved independently, while the regularized separator, pairwise, neutrality, reconstruction, recovery-complexity, and replay-soundness claims await application of the two explicit hypotheses.

project_justification.gap: The closest nonlinear result already identifies the complete binary adjacency matrix and uses measured pure descendants recursively, but its construction exhaustively searches subset families and gives no explicit polynomial observed-query budget. Moreover, its Conditions 1--3 do not make conditional-mean Jacobian rank invariant across all smooth versions: the retained published-class boundary example reaches a RankPeel pair with ranks one and two under two valid extensions.
project_justification.niche: On the strict subclass where every adaptive predictor support is first-jet determining and every restricted latent separator admits a fibre-coherent conditional-mean representative, the same graph target can be approached by deterministic pairwise block discovery and monotone parent deletion. The fibre-coherence restriction is a latent, query-specific analytic hypothesis rather than an observable test.
project_justification.fill: The repaired contribution is a conditional recovery certificate: graph-specific pure-surrogate cuts and private paths combine with a topological bottleneck to yield the exact rank decisions once the two query-regularity hypotheses hold. RankPeel then has a quadratic oracle-call budget and a replayable transcript. This is an algorithmic result on a strict subclass, not an unchanged-class strengthening of the published identification theorem.

body.related_work: Prashant, Ng, Zhang, and Huang identify the full binary adjacency matrix up to latent permutation and use measured pure descendants as recursive surrogates in an exhaustive construction. Their result informs RankPeel, but the two promises are not matched after the analytic boundary result: RankPeel's law-invariant recovery theorem is restricted to a query-local first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent strict subclass, while its unconditional contribution is only the deterministic oracle protocol and execution bound. Huang, Low, Xie, Glymour, and Zhang motivate the pure-descendant surrogate motif in a linear IL\(^{2}\)H model, with different covariance-rank assumptions and a Markov-equivalence target. Kong, Huang, Xie, Xing, Chi, and Zhang study nonlinear latent hierarchies through invertible representation recovery rather than this observed-law derivative-rank protocol. Sullivant, Talaska, and Draisma motivate separating graph-forced upper bounds from generic path-based lower bounds in linear Gaussian models. Chen and Fang and Cattaneo, Feng, and Shigida concern the distinct statistical problems of rank testing and uniform derivative inference.
body.technical_internal_limitation: The graph-side early-kill analysis found no surrogate-cut counterexample in the prescribed \(676\) three-level configurations, but finite enumeration is not a proof; the recursive pure-surrogate lemma supplies the proof. The analytic obstruction is decisive: the unchanged published Conditions 1--3 allow a smooth boundary member whose conditional-mean Jacobian rank depends on the chosen \(C^1\) version. The repaired results therefore require query-local first-jet determinacy and latent separator fibre coherence. These conditions are not claimed observable, and no blanket separator-equals-rank identity, saturated-rank assumption, or faithfulness inheritance after latent contraction is used.
body.honest_scope: The structural target remains the full binary adjacency matrix modulo independent within-layer latent relabeling. The unchanged Prashant--Ng--Zhang--Huang class is not law-invariantly recovered by RankPeel: the explicit one-latent four-measurement counterexample can force an unstable pair and \(\bot\). Exact recovery, its recovery interpretation in the complexity theorem, and graph soundness of replay are limited to the strict query-local first-jet-determining, fibre-coherent subclass. Fibre coherence refers to latent separators and is not observable. For arbitrary oracle inputs, only termination, the \(p^2+p\) call bound, bookkeeping bounds, and deterministic replay are claimed. The note does not provide polynomial-time oracle evaluation, nonparametric Jacobian estimation, finite-sample recovery, or practical CelebA consistency. Nonsingular linear Gaussian members satisfy version stability and reduce the queried ranks to cross-covariance ranks.
